---
title: "suest2"
subtitle: "Seemingly unrelated estimation of separately fit models"
---

`suest2` combines models that were estimated separately into one set of
results, so that coefficients, predictions, and marginal effects from
different models can be tested against each other with `test`, `lincom`,
`nlcom`, or `margins`. It is the engine underneath
[`mecompare`](../mecompare/index.html), [`meinequality`](../meinequality/index.html),
and [`totalme`](../totalme/index.html), and it can be used on its own.

<!-- CHECK: one or two sentences on what suest2 adds over Stata's suest (the

## Installation

```stata
net install suest2, from("https://tdmize.github.io/data/suest2") replace
```

<!-- CHECK: install location. -->

## Basic use

Fit and store the models, then combine them and refer to each model's
coefficients by equation name:

```{.stata-run}
. sysuse nlsw88, clear
(NLSW, 1988 extract)

. drop if missing(union)
(368 observations deleted)

. 
. quietly logit union i.collgrad c.age i.south, vce(robust)

. estimates store m1

. 
. quietly logit union i.collgrad c.age i.south c.wage c.ttl_exp, vce(robust)

. estimates store m2

. 
. suest2 m1 m2

Simultaneous results for m1, m2                          Number of obs = 1,878

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
              |               Robust
              | Coefficient  std. err.      z    P>|z|     [95% conf. interval]
--------------+----------------------------------------------------------------
m1_union      |
     collgrad |
College grad  |      0.507      0.119    4.246   0.000        0.273       0.741
          age |      0.009      0.018    0.519   0.604       -0.026       0.044
              |
        south |
       South  |     -0.747      0.116   -6.431   0.000       -0.974      -0.519
        _cons |     -1.340      0.704   -1.903   0.057       -2.720       0.040
--------------+----------------------------------------------------------------
m2_union      |
     collgrad |
College grad  |      0.311      0.132    2.356   0.018        0.052       0.570
          age |      0.008      0.018    0.428   0.668       -0.028       0.043
              |
        south |
       South  |     -0.677      0.118   -5.719   0.000       -0.909      -0.445
         wage |      0.054      0.014    3.820   0.000        0.026       0.081
      ttl_exp |      0.006      0.013    0.469   0.639       -0.020       0.032
        _cons |     -1.761      0.719   -2.448   0.014       -3.171      -0.351
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```

The combined results are now the active estimates, so `lincom`, `test`,
`nlcom`, and `margins` work on them, with each model's coefficients referred to
by the equation names shown in the output.

## Documentation

`help suest2` in Stata documents the syntax and options. Examples of the full
workflow are on the [`mecompare`](../mecompare/index.html) pages.
